meta.purpose: Authored policy set for leave-one-POLICY-out (LOPO), Patent #6 P1.
meta.design_note: Each policy prescribes ONE safe action per addressed (role,data) cell. Prescriptions are drawn from the real CAID allowed set {withhold, escalate}. Two binding constraints are enforced by construction (verified by the driver at load time): (1) NO cell has a constant prescription across policies -> role/data alone cannot predict the target; (2) NO policy has a constant prescription across cells -> policy identity alone cannot predict the target. Together they force role(x)data (x) policy composition, so a model that ignores role/data (feature-ablation control) or ignores the policy descriptor (descriptor-ablation control) must fail. This is the property that makes LOPO here a non-trivial generalization test, unlike a resolved-mask-in-input design.
meta.cells: the 5 addressed diagonal (role,data) pairs, in DesignSpec order
meta.action_vocabulary_note: prescriptions restricted to {withhold, escalate}; recommend/disclose remain the violation actions (never prescribed).
meta.provenance: SYNTHETIC / AUTHORED. NOT from caid_v1.json. Policy #0 is real-SHAPED (safe-action-only) but is an authored generalization probe, not the real normative policy. Real caid_v1.json specifies only a denied set per pair (recommend,disclose) with a global allowed set {withhold,escalate}; it does NOT single out one prescribed action per cell. Do not present LOPO numbers as evidence about the real policy.
